title: Order the videos by speed
headerExplanation: First, watch the four videos and then order them by speed by dragging them. You can watch them as many times as you want.
selectionText: Press the start button after reading the explanation and entering your information.
explanation: In this exercise you will evaluate different systems that generate human animations. In each exercise, you will be shown 4 videos. You have to watch these videos, in any way you want. You may watch them all at the same time, one after another... however you prefer. You will be able to rewatch them any number of times.

Then, you will have to order the 4 videos from fastest to slowest. In other words, the animation with faster and more vivid movement should go on the most left, and then go slower and slower to the right, the most right one being the slowest.
Do not attend to the realism or quality of the videos, only pay attention to the speed and vivacity of the movements.
To order the videos, you can click and drag them. After ordering the videos, send the response by clicking the send button on the bottom.
The test contains attention checks. In these attention checks, you will have to rank the videos as the check asks. If you fail more than one attention check, you will be disqualified.
Thank you in advance for spending time to complete this task. Your participation is very useful and important to us.
explanationSelecting: In this exercise you will evaluate different systems that generate human animations. In each exercise, you will be shown 3 videos and a reference image. You have to watch these videos, in any way you want. You may watch them all at the same time, one after another... however you prefer. You will be able to rewatch them any number of times.
Then, you will have to select the video that most resembles the reference pose.
Do not attend to the realism or quality of the videos, only pay attention to the animation's resemblance to the reference pose.
To select the video, you can click the button under the video you want to choose. After choosing the video, send the response by clicking the send button on the bottom.
The test contains attention checks. In these attention checks, you will have to choose one specific video as the check asks. If you fail more than one attention check, you will be disqualified.
Thank you in advance for spending time to complete this task. Your participation is very useful and important to us.
mainQuestionOrdering: Drag the videos to rank them from fastest (left) to slowest (right).
mainQuestionSelecting: Select the video that most resembles the reference pose.
